scope: Reviewed immutable static-output previews, bounded approved browser verification, persistent artifacts and feedback

assistant_installed_tests.skip_reason: The separate Code product is not included in the installed consumer.

validation.browser_ui: Passed real Chromium UI flow, separate publication/browser approval, screenshot, anchored feedback, stale evidence and mobile viewport.
validation.agent: Passed actual Code composition: preview_verify waits for stage-3 reviewed approval; cancellation closes Chromium and persists failure.
validation.native: Passed temporary app fixture: native publication and browser reviews, screenshot displayed, controlled quit, host and preview ports closed. Native visual check preceded final cancellation/persistence polish; final source, browser UI and packaged Node were retested afterwards.
validation.bundle: Final Tauri release build passed. Production Playwright, bundled static worker and real Chromium verified using bundled Node. Host authentication, duplicate lock, restart and parent EOF smoke passed.

limitations: Static HTML/compiled exports only; no attachment to arbitrary framework servers, HMR or backend-dependent previews.
Chromium must already be installed for the bundled Playwright version; no automatic download.
Existing runtimes retain their original tool fingerprint and pending approvals. Agent browser tools are enabled only for newly initialized local runtimes; manual checks remain available.
Observed source provenance is not a certification that the build incorporated that source. Unknown or changed revisions are marked stale.
No real provider request or public deployment was performed.
